propositions: Natural fold silently launders orphan events by retiring them and citing their UUIDs in source_event_uuids without replaying their effects, erasing ORPHAN_EVENT signal and converting repairable damage into unrepairable loss at the first threshold crossing after a race.

The fold enumeration must exclude un-cited pre-snapshot events (orphans per fsck definition) from both retirement and source_event_uuids citation, leaving them unretired/un-cited so the repair window and fsck signal survive indefinitely.
Pre-snapshot foldable candidates must defer from compaction while their governing snapshot remains young to prevent silent burial under a pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT.
fsck --repair-snapshots must enforce the same _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE routing as fsck --repair instead of rebuilding unconditionally on any ORPHAN_EVENT.

A shared orphan predicate (is_snapshot_orphan anchored to the latest prior SNAPSHOT) must be extracted and reused across compact_txn and fsck to ensure the two doors cannot disagree on orphan classification.
